text: A Multi-Step TSP Improvement Sequence A useful way to understand memetic behavior in TSP is as follows: @ crossover creates a new route with promising global structure @ mutation perturbs that structure @ 2-opt removes obvious crossings @ further local moves shorten segments incrementally So the memetic sequence is often: rough good tour — crossing-free tour — locally polished tour. This is important pedagogically because it shows that local search is not doing global discovery. It is doing: structural repair and geometric improvement on top of what evolution already discovered.
